question: What is the minimum age of a candidate to become the president of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __35 years__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The minimum age required for an Indian Citizen to become the president of the country is 35 years.**
 
• The president is the head of the Indian state.
 
• The president is the first citizen of India and acts as the symbol of Unity, Integrity, and Solidarity of the Nation.
 
• The election of the president is not done by the people of the Nation but by the members of the Electoral College.
 
• **To be eligible for the election of the president every citizen has to fulfill certain criteria.**
 
 
• The person should be a Citizen of India
 
• The Person should have completed 35 years of age.
 
• **The Person should be qualified for election as a member of the Lok Sabha.**
 
• The Person should not hold any office under the Union Government or any State Government or any local or public authority.
 
 
 
• The oath of office to the President is administered by the Chief Justice of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• I**mportant Articles related to the President of India**

 
 
• **Art. 52: The President of India.**
 
• **Art. 54: Election of President.**
 
• **Art. 56: Terms of Office of President.**
 
• **Art. 60: Oaths or Affirmations by the President.**
 
• **Art. 61: Impeachment of President.**
 
• **Art. 72: Powers of President to grant pardons.**
 
• **Art. 123: Power of President to promulgate ordinances.**
